Restore resolution of this exact existing video-game printed-art UV texture. This is an edit, not a recreation. The input is the whole authored map enlarged by nearest-neighbor for precise coordinate guidance. Preserve the COMPLETE canvas and every existing printed mark, glyph silhouette, line of text, figure contour, hatching, illustration, frame and black gutter exactly as it currently looks. Do not understand, read, translate, complete or typeset any printed content. No new letters or reconstructed pseudo-letters. Keep the source ink outlines and tiny text softness exactly. Preserve the exact color and contrast of the input; no darkening ink, no extra cracks/stains, no new rivets or figure detail. No sharpening of lettering. Do not repaint any inked part. Output the whole texture alone, same aspect ratio and pixel coordinate composition, at high resolution. Existing text is immutable bitmap decal content; never rebuild it.
Image1 is the ONLY whole-atlas edit target. Images2,3,4 are MAGNIFIED EXACT SOURCE-PIXEL probes of two red printed areas and the handwriting, solely to show the immutable shapes clearly. Do not paste these probes into the output. Do not return a collage or these crops. Return only the full six-page atlas from image1, keeping all marks at their exact original coordinates. The red headings must retain those SAME blurry irregular glyph silhouettes, not clean reinterpreted symbols. Handwriting must retain those same jagged pixel strokes and loops, no new calligraphy. Preserve original blocky ink texture where it is blocky; do not fill ambiguous gaps or make lines smooth. It is acceptable for the print to stay soft and low-resolution. Only the blank paper material can gain subtle detail. Hard constraint: do not redraw any text or illustration, no cleaned-up geometry of printed letters.
